library(scales)

load(here("Data", "shiny_data.RData"))
load(here("Data", "built_ucdb.RData"))

## UI



```{r ui}
ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Urban Definitions Data Shiny Web App"),
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      id = "sidebarMenu",
      menuItem("eUFA", tabName = "eUFA", icon = icon("chart-bar")),
      menuItem("Urban Centres", tabName = "UrbanCentres", icon = icon("city"))
    )
  ),
  dashboardBody(
    tabItems(
      tabItem(
        tabName = "eUFA",
        sidebarLayout(
          sidebarPanel(
            width = 2,
            selectInput("year", "Select Year:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Year)),
            selectInput("location", "Select City:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Location[order(oe_data_shi$Location)])),
            selectInput("comparators", "Select Comparison Group:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Comparators), selected = "MENA"),
            radioButtons("section", "Select:", choices = c("GDP per capita (PPP)", "Employment structure"))
          ),
          mainPanel(
            width = 10,
            uiOutput("dynamicPlot"),
            DT::dataTableOutput("dataTable")
          )
        )
      ),
      tabItem(
        tabName = "UrbanCentres",
        sidebarLayout(
          sidebarPanel(
            width = 2,
            h4("Select options below:"),
            selectInput("urbanCentre", "Select City:", choices = c("", sort(unique(built_ucdb$Urban_centre[
  !grepl("^\\?|^[^a-zA-Z0-9]|\\d|\\?+", built_ucdb$Urban_centre) & 
  !is.na(built_ucdb$Built_rel_change)])))
                        ),
            selectInput("comparators", "Select Comparison Group:", choices = unique(oe_data_shi$Comparators), selected = "MENA")
          ),
          mainPanel(
            width = 10,
            uiOutput("urbanOutput"),
            DT::dataTableOutput("urbanDataTable")
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
```

## Server


```{r sever, echo=FALSE}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Dynamic Plot UI
  output$dynamicPlot <- renderUI({
    if (input$sidebarMenu == "eUFA") {
      if (input$section == "GDP per capita (PPP)") {
        plotOutput("plotOutput_eUFA")
      } else if (input$section == "Employment structure") {
        plotOutput("employmentPlot_eUFA")
      }
    }
  })

  urbanDatacomparators <- reactive({
    req(input$comparators)
    built_ucdb %>%
      filter(Comparators == input$comparators & !is.na(Built_rel_change))
  })

  # Data Filters for eUFA
  filteredData_eUFA <- reactive({
    req(input$location)
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Location == input$location)
  })

  filteredDataByYear_eUFA <- reactive({
    req(input$year, input$location)
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Year == input$year & Location == input$location)
  })

  comparisonGroupData_eUFA <- reactive({
    req(input$comparators)
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Comparators == input$comparators & Location != input$location)
  })

  comparisonGroupDataByYear_eUFA <- reactive({
    req(input$year, input$comparators)
    oe_data_shi %>%
      filter(Year == input$year & Comparators == input$comparators & Location != input$location)
  })

  similarData <- reactive({
    req(input$year, input$location)

    selected_city <- filteredDataByYear_eUFA()
    comparison_cities <- comparisonGroupDataByYear_eUFA()

    employment_cols <- c(
      "Public_Services_Emp_Pct", "Industry_Emp_Pct",
      "Financial_Busines_Services_Emp_Pct", "Consumer_Services_Emp_Pct",
      "Agriculture_Emp_Pct", "Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct"
    )

    distances <- comparison_cities %>%
      mutate(distance = sqrt(
        (Public_Services_Emp_Pct - selected_city$Public_Services_Emp_Pct)^2 +
          (Industry_Emp_Pct - selected_city$Industry_Emp_Pct)^2 +
          (Financial_Busines_Services_Emp_Pct - selected_city$Financial_Busines_Services_Emp_Pct)^2 +
          (Consumer_Services_Emp_Pct - selected_city$Consumer_Services_Emp_Pct)^2 +
          (Agriculture_Emp_Pct - selected_city$Agriculture_Emp_Pct)^2 +
          (Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct - selected_city$Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct)^2
      ))

    similar_city <- distances %>%
      arrange(distance) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)

    different_city <- distances %>%
      arrange(desc(distance)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)

    bind_rows(similar_city, different_city)
  })

  # Data Table Output for eUFA
  output$dataTable <- DT::renderDataTable({
    if (input$sidebarMenu == "eUFA") {
      if (input$section == "GDP per capita (PPP)") {
        data <- filteredDataByYear_eUFA() %>%
          select(-ends_with("Emp_Pct"))

        comparison_data <- comparisonGroupDataByYear_eUFA() %>%
          select(-ends_with("Emp_Pct"))

        combined_data <- bind_rows(data, comparison_data)
        combined_data <- combined_data %>%
          mutate(GDP_per_capita_PPP = scales::comma(GDP_per_capita_PPP * 1000, accuracy = 0.1))

        datatable(combined_data)
      } else if (input$section == "Employment structure") {
        data <- filteredDataByYear_eUFA() %>%
          select(-ends_with("Emp_Pct"))

        comparison_data <- comparisonGroupDataByYear_eUFA() %>%
          select(-ends_with("Emp_Pct"))

        combined_data <- bind_rows(data, comparison_data)
        combined_data <- combined_data %`>%
          mutate(GDP_per_capita_PPP = scales::comma(GDP_per_capita_PPP * 1000, accuracy = 0.1))

        datatable(combined_data)
      }
    }
  })

  # Plot Output for GDP per capita (PPP)
  output$plotOutput_eUFA <- renderPlot({
    if (input$sidebarMenu == "eUFA" && input$section == "GDP per capita (PPP)") {
      ggplot() +
        geom_line(
          data = comparisonGroupData_eUFA(),
          aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, group = Location),
          color = "gray80",
          alpha = 0.6
        ) +
        geom_line(
          data = filteredData_eUFA(),
          aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, group = Location),
          color = "red",
          linewidth = 1.2
        ) +
        geom_text_repel(
          data = comparisonGroupData_eUFA() %>% filter(Year == max(oe_data_shi$Year)),
          aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, label = Location),
          color = "gray40",
          size = 3,
          direction = "y",
          hjust = -0.2,
          segment.size = 0.3,
          force = 0.5,
          max.overlaps = 20
        ) +
        geom_text_repel(
          data = filteredData_eUFA() %>% filter(Year == max(oe_data_shi$Year)),
          aes(x = Year, y = GDP_per_capita_PPP, label = Location),
          color = "red",
          size = 5,
          fontface = "bold",
          direction = "y",
          hjust = -0.9, # Push farther
          segment.size = 0.5,
          force = 0.5,
          max.overlaps = 20
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "GDP per Capita PPP over Years",
          x = "Year",
          y = "GDP per Capita PPP"
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
          labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1, suffix = "K")
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5)
        )
    }
  })

  # Plot Output for Employment Structure with Similar and Distant Cities
  output$employmentPlot_eUFA <- renderPlot({
    if (input$sidebarMenu == "eUFA" && input$section == "Employment structure") {
      columns_to_pivot_Emp_Pct <- c(
        "Public_Services_Emp_Pct",
        "Industry_Emp_Pct",
        "Financial_Busines_Services_Emp_Pct",
        "Consumer_Services_Emp_Pct",
        "Agriculture_Emp_Pct",
        "Transport_Information_Communic_Services_Emp_Pct"
      )

      selected_city_data <- filteredDataByYear_eUFA()
      comparator_data <- similarData()

      most_similar <- comparator_data %>%
        arrange(distance) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1)

      most_different <- comparator_data %>%
        arrange(desc(distance)) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1)

      plot_data_list <- list(
        selected = selected_city_data,
        similar = most_similar,
        different = most_different
      )

      plots <- lapply(names(plot_data_list), function(city_type) {
        data <- plot_data_list[[city_type]] %>%
          pivot_longer(
            cols = all_of(columns_to_pivot_Emp_Pct),
            names_to = "Employment_sector",
            values_to = "Percentage"
          ) %>%
          mutate(Employment_sector = gsub("(_Emp_Pct|_)", " ", Employment_sector))

        title <- switch(city_type,
          "selected" = paste("Selected City:", unique(data$Location)),
          "similar" = paste("Most Similar:", unique(data$Location)),
          "different" = paste("Most Different:", unique(data$Location))
        )

        ggplot(data, aes(x = 1, y = Percentage, fill = Employment_sector)) +
          geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = wes_palette("Zissou1",
            n = length(unique(data$Employment_sector)),
            type = "continuous"
          )) +
          labs(title = title) +
          theme_minimal() +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), name = NULL) +
          scale_x_discrete(name = NULL, breaks = NULL) +
          theme(
            legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.title = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
          ) +
          geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Percentage, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 3
          )
      })

      gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 3)
    }
  })

  # Urban Centres
  output$urbanOutput <- renderUI({
    if (!is.null(input$urbanCentre) && input$urbanCentre != "") {
      plotOutput("urbanPlotCity")
    } else if (!is.null(input$comparators) && input$comparators != "") {
      plotOutput("urbanPlotcomparators")
    } else if (!is.null(input$country) && input$country != "") {
      plotOutput("urbanPlotCountry")
    }
  })

  urbanDataCity <- reactive({
    req(input$urbanCentre)
    built_ucdb %>%
      filter(Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre)
  })

  urbanDataCountry <- reactive({
    req(input$country)
    built_ucdb %>%
      filter(Country == input$country)
  })

  output$urbanDataTable <- DT::renderDataTable({
    if (!is.null(input$urbanCentre) && input$urbanCentre != "") {
      city_data <- urbanDataCity()
      city_summary <- city_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(Built_rel_change)) %>%
        summarise(
          Value = unique(Built_rel_change)
        )
      datatable(city_summary, options = list(pageLength = 5), rownames = FALSE)
    } else if (!is.null(input$comparators) && input$comparators != "") {
      comparators_data <- urbanDatacomparators()
      comparators_summary <- comparators_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(Built_rel_change)) %>%
        summarise(
          Average = mean(Built_rel_change, na.rm = TRUE),
          Minimum = if (all(is.na(Built_rel_change))) NA else min(Built_rel_change, na.rm = TRUE),
          Maximum = if (all(is.na(Built_rel_change))) NA else max(Built_rel_change, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      datatable(comparators_summary, options = list(pageLength = 5), rownames = FALSE)
    } else if (!is.null(input$country) && input$country != "") {
      country_data <- urbanDataCountry()
      country_summary <- country_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(Built_rel_change)) %>%
        summarise(
          Average = mean(Built_rel_change, na.rm = TRUE),
          Minimum = if (all(is.na(Built_rel_change))) NA else max(Built_rel_change, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      datatable(country_summary, options = list(pageLength = 5), rownames = FALSE)
    }
  })

  output$urbanPlotCity <- renderPlot({
    city_data <- urbanDataCity()
    comparators_data <- urbanDatacomparators()

    combined_data <- comparators_data %>%
      bind_rows(city_data) %>%
      filter(Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre | Urban_centre %in% comparators_data$Urban_centre) %>%
      arrange(desc(Built_rel_change))

    ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = reorder(Urban_centre, Built_rel_change), y = Built_rel_change)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "gray80")) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = combined_data %>% filter(Urban_centre != input$urbanCentre),
        aes(label = Urban_centre), size = 3, color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = combined_data %>% filter(Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre),
        aes(label = Urban_centre), size = 4, color = "red", fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Built-up Surface Relative Change for"
                      , input$urbanCentre
                      , "and Comparison Group"),
        x = "Urban Centre", y = "Built-up Surface Relative Change"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  })

  output$urbanPlotcomparators <- renderPlot({
    comparators_data <- urbanDatacomparators()
    city_data <- urbanDataCity()

    combined_data <- comparators_data %>%
      bind_rows(city_data) %>%
      filter(Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre | Urban_centre %in% comparators_data$Urban_centre) %>%
      arrange(desc(Built_rel_change))

    ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = reorder(Urban_centre, Built_rel_change), y = Built_rel_change)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "gray80")) +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = combined_data %>% filter(Urban_centre != input$urbanCentre),
        aes(label = Urban_centre), size = 3, color = "black"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = combined_data %>% filter(Urban_centre == input$urbanCentre),
        aes(label = Urban_centre), size = 4, color = "red", fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Built-up Surface Relative Change in"
                      , input$comparators
                      , "with", input$urbanCentre),
        x = "Urban Centre", y = "Built-up Surface Relative Change 2010 -2020"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  })
}
```

```{r deploy}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
